integrity: Analytical Chen--Stein proof with finite deterministic and seeded checks; finite tests are not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Exact i.i.d. Pareto type-I lengths; the point process marks consecutive sorted triple violations, not all triangular triples; quantitative bound can be vacuous outside sparse regimes. Priority requires independent assessment.
title: A Poisson critical window for triangle formation in Pareto stick samples
